parameters.componentSubtitle: Bootstrap Grid component for a block, which uses Drupal Views.

description.component: A Drupal View Block component rendered as a responsive Bootstrap grid layout. Each item in the view appears inside a column that is responsive at various breakpoints.

rows.name: Rows
rows.description: An array of items. Each item is wrapped in a responsive column.

grid_utility_classes.name: Grid Row Utility Classes
grid_utility_classes.description: Use to add extra Bootstrap utility classes for the grid `row`. E.g. `row-cols-1 row-cols-sm-2 row-cols-md-4`. ( Do not add `grid`, or `row`).

column_utility_classes.name: Column Utility Classes
column_utility_classes.description: Use to add extra Bootstrap utility classes for the column `col`. E.g. `gy-4 g-sm-4` or `mb-4`. ( Do not add `col` or `col-[*]`).

col_xs.name: Column width of items at xs breakpoint
col_xs.description: Set the number of columns each item should take up at the xs breakpoint and higher.

col_sm.name: Column width of items at sm breakpoint
col_sm.description: Set the number of columns each item should take up at the sm breakpoint and higher.

col_md.name: Column width of items at md breakpoint
col_md.description: Set the number of columns each item should take up at the md breakpoint and higher.

col_lg.name: Column width of items at lg breakpoint
col_lg.description: Set the number of columns each item should take up at the lg breakpoint and higher.

col_xl.name: Column width of items at xl breakpoint
col_xl.description: Set the number of columns each item should take up at the xl breakpoint and higher.

col_xxl.name: Column width of items at xxl breakpoint
col_xxl.description: Set the number of columns each item should take up at the xl breakpoint and higher.

attributes.name: Attributes
attributes.description: HTML attributes to apply to the outer grid container.
